page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-56 is a memory-optimized server instance designed for memory-intensive workloads. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 744.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a high memory-to-core ratio of 13.29 GB per vCPU, making it suitable for applications requiring large amounts of RAM relative to compute resources.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. There are also zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents a specialized resource allocation where the investment is heavily weighted toward memory capacity rather than local storage or accelerator hardware.

This server is designed for workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and heavy data-caching layers. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention, supporting stable execution of memory-bound enterprise applications.
